## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, or `git rebase --signoff origin/main` for a branch): the
      `Signed-off-by:` line names the author of the commit and accepts the terms of
      `CONTRIBUTING.md`, "Licensing of contributions"
      (DCO 1.1 and the relicensing grant the dual licensing needs). The **DCO** check fails otherwise.
- [ ] Documentation (English and the `.it.md` copies), `CHANGELOG.md` and the traceability matrix are updated when
      the behaviour changes.
- [ ] The checks that cover the change pass locally.
